lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Incheon Delivery, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Gate 32, Information Bravo, request IFR clearance to Bangkok.

lines.speaker: delivery
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Incheon Delivery, cleared to Bangkok Airport via SEL1N departure, flight planned route. Climb and maintain flight level 190, squawk 5102.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Cleared to Bangkok Airport via SEL1N departure, climb and maintain flight level 190, squawk 5102, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: delivery
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, read-back is correct. Contact Ground on 121.4 for pushback.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Incheon Ground, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Gate 32, request pushback and start.

lines.speaker: ground
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Incheon Ground, pushback and start approved, face South, Runway 34R.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Pushback and start approved, face South, runway 34R, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: Brakes released, commencing pushback.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Pushback acknowledged, starting engines.

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: Pushback complete. Set parking brake. Stand by for equipment clearance.

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: Tug disconnected, all equipment clear. Have a good flight to Bangkok!

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Incheon Ground, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, request taxi.

lines.speaker: ground
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, taxi to holding point runway 34R via taxiway November 2 and Alpha, hold short of runway 34R.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Taxi to holding point runway 34R via November 2 and Alpha, hold short of runway 34R, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: ground
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, contact Tower on 118.2.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Tower on 118.2, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Incheon Tower, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, holding short of runway 34R.

lines.speaker: tower
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Incheon Tower, line up and wait runway 34R.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Line up and wait runway 34R, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: tower
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, wind 290 at 8 knots, runway 34R, cleared for takeoff.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Cleared for takeoff, runway 34R, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Takeoff clearance confirmed. 80 knots, V1, rotate, positive rate, gear up.

lines.speaker: tower
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, contact Departure on 125.15. Good day.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Departure 125.15, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three. Thank you, good day.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Incheon Departure, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, passing 2,500 for flight level 190.

lines.speaker: departure
lines.text: Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three, Incheon Departure, radar contact. Climb and maintain flight level 290, turn right heading 210.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Climb and maintain flight level 290, turn right heading 210, Jeju Air Two-Five-Zero-Three.
